facts.statement: Demandasaurus was first named in 2011 by a team of researchers including Fidel Torcida Fernández-Baldor and Leonardo Salgado.
facts.quote: It was first named by Fidel Torcida Fernández-Baldor, José Ignacio Canudo, Pedro Huerta, Diego Montero, Xabier Pereda Suberbiola, and Leonardo Salgado in 2011

facts.statement: Fossils of Demandasaurus were first collected between 2002 and 2004 by the Archaeological-Palaeontological Group of Salas de los Infantes.
facts.quote: Demandasaurus was first collected between 2002 and 2004 by the Archaeological−Palaeontological Group of Salas de los Infantes

facts.statement: Demandasaurus fossils come from the Upper Barremian-Lower Aptian strata of the Castrillo de la Reina Formation.
facts.quote: The strata at the site comes from the Upper Barremian-Lower Aptian of the Castrillo de la Reina Formation

facts.statement: Demandasaurus possessed cervical vertebrae with bone structures not found in other dinosaurs.
facts.quote: cervical vertebrae with bone structures that are not present in other dinosaurs

facts.statement: The neural arches of Demandasaurus dorsal vertebrae were crossed entirely by two pneumatic fossae.
facts.quote: neural arches of the dorsal vertebrae crossed entirely by two pneumatic fossae

facts.statement: Demandasaurus had a rounded snout shape that contrasted with the square contours of other diplodocoids.
facts.quote: The rounded shape of its snout also contrasts with the most square contour snouts of the rest of the diplodocoids

facts.statement: Demandasaurus lived approximately 129 to 123 million years ago during the early Cretaceous, between the Barremian and Aptian stages.
facts.quote: vivió hace unos 129-123 millones de años, a mediados de la época Cretácico temprano entre el Barremiense y el Aptiense

facts.statement: Demandasaurus lived in what is now Europe.
facts.quote: en lo que ahora es la Europa

facts.statement: Demandasaurus measured about 10 meters in length, 3.5 meters high at the hips, and weighed 5 tons.
facts.quote: Demandasaurus media alrededor del 10 metros de largo, 3,5 metros de alto en la cadera y 5 toneladas de peso

facts.statement: Demandasaurus fossils were recovered from the Castrillo la Reina Formation at the Tenadas de los Vallejos II site in the Sierra de la Demanda, Burgos Province, Spain.
facts.quote: Los fósiles de Demandasaurus han sido recuperados de la formación Castrillo la Reina en el yacimiento de Tenadas de los Vallejos II, Sierra de la Demanda, provincia de Burgos, España

facts.statement: Demandasaurus was named in 2011 by Fidel Torcida Fernández-Baldor, José Ignacio Canudo, Pedro Huerta, Diego Montero, Xabier Pereda Suberbiola, and Leonardo Salgado.
facts.quote: Fue nombrado en 2011 por Fidel Torcida Fernández-Baldor, José Ignacio Canudo, Pedro Huerta, Diego Montero, Xabier Pereda Suberbiola y Leonardo Salgado

facts.statement: Demandasaurus was the first Diplodocoidean sauropod from the Early Cretaceous, approximately 125 million years ago, described in Spain.
facts.quote: Es el primer saurópodo Diplodocoideo del Cretácico Inferior, hace aproximadamente125 millones de años descrito en España

facts.statement: Demandasaurus is recognized as the only diagnosed rebbachisaurid species in Laurasia.
facts.quote: También se reconoce como la única especie de rebaquisáurido diagnosticada en Laurasia

facts.statement: Demandasaurus has been used to support the hypothesis of an African origin for the species.
facts.quote: ha sido un argumento aportado para desarrollar la hipótesis de un origen africano de Demandasaurus

facts.statement: Demandasaurus lived from the Barremian to the Aptian, between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 119.57 million years ago)

facts.statement: Demandasaurus belongs to the parent group Rebbachisaurinae.
Demandasaurus is classified within the family Rebbachisauridae.
